facts.statement: Fossils of Adamanasuchus have been found in the Chinle Group in Arizona.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found from several localities from the Chinle Group in Arizona

facts.statement: The locality where Adamanasuchus was named lends its name to the Adamanian land vertebrate faunachron.
facts.quote: The locality from which it was named after also lends its name to the Adamanian LVF (land vertebrate faunachron).

facts.statement: Adamanasuchus was a relatively large aetosaur characterized by unique armor plating.
facts.quote: It was a relatively large genus of aetosaur with unique armor plating.

facts.statement: The paramedian osteoderms of Adamanasuchus are narrow, measuring approximately 200 to 225 mm, and arched at about a 30-degree angle.
facts.quote: The paramedian osteoderms are narrow (~200-225 mm) and arched at a ~30º angle

facts.statement: Adamanasuchus is known from partial fossil material including dorsal armor, caudal vertebrae, and a femur.
facts.quote: This genus is known from partial fossil material of the dorsal armor, caudal vertebrae and a femur.

facts.statement: The dorsal armor of Adamanasuchus is distinctive, representing a mosaic of features found in only a few aetosaur genera.
facts.quote: The dorsal armor of Adamanasuchus are distinctive and represent a mosaic of features only found on few aetosaur genera

facts.statement: Adamanasuchus lived in the Chinle Formation in present-day Arizona during the Late Triassic period.
facts.quote: Adamanasuchus lived in what is now Arizona during the Late Triassic period in the Chinle Formation.

facts.statement: Adamanasuchus lived contemporaneously with many other aetosaur genera including Longosuchus, Coahomasuchus, Stagonolepis, Desmatosuchus, Tecovasuchus, Paratypothorax, Typothorax, Rioarribasuchus, Aetosaurus, and Redondasuchus.
facts.quote: It lived at the same time of many different genera of aetosaurs such as Longosuchus, Coahomasuchus, Stagonolepis, Desmatosuchus, Tecovasuchus, Paratypothorax, Typothorax, Rioarribasuchus, Aetosaurus, and Redondasuchus.

facts.statement: The genus Adamanasuchus was originally described anonymously in 1983.
The type species of Adamanasuchus is A. rectori, described anonymously in 1983, while A. eisenhardtae was described by Lucas, Hunt & Spielmann in 2007.
facts.quote: subdivision: A. rectori (Anónimo, 1983) (especie tipo) A. eisenhardtae Lucas, Hunt & Spielmann, 2007

facts.statement: Adamanasuchus belongs to the family Stagonolepididae.
Adamanasuchus is classified within the order Aetosauria.
Adamanasuchus is classified within the class Sauropsida.
Adamanasuchus belongs to the subfamily Desmatosuchinae.
Adamanasuchus is classified as a reptile.
The time range for Adamanasuchus is from 227.3 to 205.7 million years ago, specifically within the Norian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Norian to Norian (227.3 to 205.7 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Adamanasuchus is an extinct genus of aetosaur that lived approximately 222 to 216.5 million years ago.
rejected.quote: Adamanasuchus is an extinct genus of aetosaur that lived during the Late Triassic period around 222-216.5 million years ago.
